consequence.statement: This is a new optional fallback for API call context entries. Existing policies keep working unchanged unless operators choose to set `apiCall.default`.

assertion.statement: Kyverno 1.13.0 adds an optional `apiCall.default` field to policy context entries (for example `spec.rules[].context[].apiCall.default` in ClusterPolicy). It sets a fallback value for the API call context entry when the API server returns an error.
